v4.6.43 — Fixes the repeating 'insufficient balance' buy error

🐛 FIXED — bots failing every buy with 'insufficient balance for USD'
• What it meant: your bot sized a buy off your TOTAL account value, but most of your cash was already invested (or reserved by open orders), so only a little USD was actually free. The broker rejected the over-sized order every time (e.g. ONDO-USD: needed $102, only $28 free).
• Now: before any buy, the bot caps the order to the cash that's ACTUALLY spendable right now (for crypto it uses your free non-margin cash; for stocks, your buying power), leaving a little headroom for fees. So instead of failing, it buys the largest amount it can afford — and if there's truly no free cash, it cleanly skips with a clear 'already fully invested' message instead of spamming errors.

This applies to every bot on both brokers (Alpaca cash and the IBKR sub-portfolio ledger).

If a bot is running on Oracle, stop and restart it so it picks up the fix.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
